source_handling: One published NWB asset is copied byte-for-byte at build time, never resolved from draft. No filtering, unit selection, spike processing, OSI computation, format conversion, or other scientific processing occurs in staging. Runtime analysis is offline.

acquisition_contract.failed_attempt_policy: Retain partial payload and attempt receipt; do not redownload automatically or silently reset the cumulative transfer budget.

files.digest_provenance: Published dandi:sha2-256 and dandi:dandi-etag in the immutable version-specific asset metadata, independently retrieved before the NWB transfer. The multipart ETag is not misrepresented as a whole-file MD5.
files.transport_provenance: The exact blob URL is published in DANDI contentUrl. Its observed S3 object version is additionally pinned; the response ETag, version ID, content length and final SHA256 must agree.
